title: When the Locker Burns
author: Felix Pemberton
blurb: Hazel Ravensworth, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
